samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: The following proposal has been made: communities should make everyday walking more convenient. Should this approach be used in every situation? Give your opinion.
requirementsVi: Nêu phần đồng ý và giới hạn.
Giải thích lợi ích lẫn trường hợp không phù hợp.
Chốt điều kiện áp dụng.
samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The suggestion that communities should make everyday walking more convenient has clear attractions. I agree with it to some extent, but I do not think it should be applied in exactly the same way in every situation. The potential benefits need to be considered alongside the needs of the people involved.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý một phần, nói rõ giới hạn ngay đầu.

paragraphs.label: Phần đồng ý
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. This is possible because a useful route to a shop or bus stop can make walking part of a journey rather than an extra task. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some routes are difficult to use. This matters because uneven paths, missing crossings and parked vehicles can create barriers. For instance, a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dùng ví dụ để giải thích trường hợp cần điều chỉnh.

paragraphs.label: Điều kiện
paragraphs.text: My own view is that the potential benefit is worth pursuing, but the conditions matter. In particular, it would be sensible to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. People should be able to understand what is expected and raise difficulties before those difficulties become a reason to give up. A flexible plan is therefore more convincing than a promise that the same method will work equally well for everyone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu điều kiện cụ thể để áp dụng.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I support the aim behind this proposal because people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. However, support should depend on whether practical barriers are addressed. A flexible approach that responds to actual needs is preferable to applying the idea everywhere without further thought.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kết luận nhất quán với đồng ý có điều kiện.

This matters because real life includes repairs, travel changes and other expenses that are hard to predict. For instance, someone may abandon a whole spending plan after paying for an urgent bicycle repair. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dùng ví dụ để giải thích trường hợp cần điều chỉnh.

paragraphs.label: Điều kiện
paragraphs.text: My own view is that the potential benefit is worth pursuing, but the conditions matter. In particular, it would be sensible to use a flexible plan and review it regularly. People should be able to understand what is expected and raise difficulties before those difficulties become a reason to give up. A flexible plan is therefore more convincing than a promise that the same method will work equally well for everyone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu điều kiện cụ thể để áp dụng.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I support the aim behind this proposal because people can see whether their income covers essential needs. However, support should depend on whether practical barriers are addressed. A flexible approach that responds to actual needs is preferable to applying the idea everywhere without further thought.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kết luận nhất quán với đồng ý có điều kiện.

samples.prompt: The following proposal has been made: people should protect some regular time for enjoyable hobbies. Should this approach be used in every situation? Give your opinion.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The suggestion that people should protect some regular time for enjoyable hobbies has clear attractions. I agree with it to some extent, but I do not think it should be applied in exactly the same way in every situation. The potential benefits need to be considered alongside the needs of the people involved.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý một phần, nói rõ giới hạn ngay đầu.

paragraphs.label: Phần đồng ý
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities. This is possible because an activity chosen for enjoyment gives people something to look forward to. For example, an office worker can spend one evening each week learning to draw with a small local group. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Sở thích giúp đổi nhịp sống; nên bắt đầu nhỏ, vừa túi tiền và không so mình với người đã giỏi.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure. This matters because expensive equipment and demanding goals may make a beginner feel unsuccessful. For instance, someone may stop practising music after trying to learn several difficult pieces in the first week. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dùng ví dụ để giải thích trường hợp cần điều chỉnh.

paragraphs.label: Điều kiện
paragraphs.text: My own view is that the potential benefit is worth pursuing, but the conditions matter. In particular, it would be sensible to begin with small goals and choose an affordable way to practise. People should be able to understand what is expected and raise difficulties before those difficulties become a reason to give up. A flexible plan is therefore more convincing than a promise that the same method will work equally well for everyone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu điều kiện cụ thể để áp dụng.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I support the aim behind this proposal because a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities. However, support should depend on whether practical barriers are addressed. A flexible approach that responds to actual needs is preferable to applying the idea everywhere without further thought.
